Class MessageParser

java.lang.Object
app.model.multi.MessageParser
public class MessageParser extends Object
The MessageParser class is responsible for parsing messages into structured objects of type ParsedMessage. It enforces a specific message format and validates the input against message type definitions and other constraints.

  • Method Details

    • parse

      public static MessageParser.ParsedMessage parse(String message) throws MessageParser.InvalidMessageFormatException
      Parses the given message string into a MessageParser.ParsedMessage object. This method expects the message to follow a specific format: three tokens separated by the "#" character. The first token should be a numeric sender ID, the second token should be a valid MsgType, and the third token represents message-specific data.
      Parameters:
      message - the string containing the message to be parsed, formatted as "senderPlayerId#msgType#data"
      Returns:
      a MessageParser.ParsedMessage object containing the parsed senderPlayerId, msgType, and data
      Throws:
      MessageParser.InvalidMessageFormatException - if the message is null, empty, improperly formatted, or contains invalid values (e.g., non-numeric senderPlayerId or invalid MsgType)
